description: Configuration for a Potato annotation task. Generated from the live schema and display registries — see potato/server_utils/config_schema.py.

annotation_schemes.description: The annotation form. Each entry renders one widget.

annotation_type.description: Annotation type, as registered in the schema registry.

Audio segmentation and annotation with waveform visualization
Best-Worst Scaling: select the best and worst item from a set
Drag-and-drop card sorting into predefined or user-created groups
GitHub PR-style code review with inline comments and file ratings
Confidence rating meta-annotation for any primary annotation
Discrete choice conjoint analysis with side-by-side profile comparison
Tag discussion acts per turn (proposal/agreement/disagreement/decision/concession) with cross-turn links to referenced proposals
Allocate a fixed budget of points across categories
Tag how each turn uses earlier context (used correctly / hallucinated / ignored) with links to the source turn
Coreference chain annotation for grouping mentions of the same entity
Cross-lane emergent-behavior tagging: mark turn-sets for collusion/groupthink/cascade/role-drift
Embodied robot episode: synchronized video streams and time-series lanes with phase, outcome and dense-reward annotation
MQM-style error span annotation with typed severity for quality evaluation
N-ary event annotation with triggers and typed arguments
SQuAD-style extractive question answering with answer span highlighting
Multi-agent failure attribution: responsible agent + decisive step + reason
Grounding evaluation: bind referring expressions to image regions or points, with an explicit not-present answer
Computer-use/GUI agent step review: per-step screenshot + action correctness + click grounding
Annotate agent-to-agent handoffs: inter-agent misalignment flags + quality
Hierarchical tree-structured multi-label selection
Image annotation with bounding boxes, polygons, freeform drawing, and landmarks
Likert scale rating
Cross-document event annotation: template slots filled with evidence from many documents
Interleaved text/image/tool reasoning trace: per-step coherence + visual-hallucination rating
Rate multiple items on a scale
Multiple-choice checkbox selection
Numeric input field
Pairwise comparison of two items (binary selection or scale rating)
Per-step process reward signals for PRM training
Display-only content (instructions, headers)
Single-choice radio button selection
Dual-thumb slider for selecting an acceptable range
Drag-and-drop ranking of items by preference or relevance
Region captioning: a free-text description per region drawn on the image, with caption agreement over matched regions
World-model rollout evaluation: frame-locked video panels with temporal violation localization, preference and counterfactual plausibility
Multi-criteria rubric evaluation grid for LLM and text quality assessment
Dropdown selection
Bipolar adjective scales for measuring connotative meaning
Slider for selecting a value in a range
Probability distribution across labels via constrained sliders
Text span annotation/highlighting with optional entity linking to knowledge bases
Create relationships/links between spans (e.g., PERSON works_for ORGANIZATION)
3D point cloud annotation with oriented cuboids, points, polylines, and per-point segments
Aligned-transcript speech-error annotation: per-segment ASR/TTS error tags + correction
Table-cell structure annotation: rows x cols grid + per-cell role (header/data/empty)
Video temporal grounding: mark gold event intervals with live IoU vs predicted
Free-form text input
Inline text editing with diff tracking for post-editing and correction tasks
Hierarchical multi-tier annotation for audio/video (ELAN-style)
Per-tool-call correctness review (right tool / args / ordering)
Tool/resource-contention timeline: per-agent lanes + shared-resource collision classification
Per-step trajectory correction/editing for SFT/DPO training data
Per-step trajectory evaluation with error taxonomy and severity scoring
Annotation of conversation tree nodes with path selection
Binary accept/reject triage for rapid data curation
Continuous visual analog scale for fine-grained magnitude estimation
Video player display
Video annotation with temporal segments, frame classification, keyframes, and object tracking
Voice/full-duplex turn-taking: dual-track timeline + barge-in/overlap classification

name.description: Unique key this scheme's answers are stored under.

assignment_strategy.description: How items are handed out to annotators.

data_files.description: Data files, relative to task_dir. Each entry is either a path string or a mapping carrying per-file overrides (see flask_server.py:493).

instance_display.$comment: Display types accepting span annotation targets: audio_dialogue, code, coding_trace, dialogue, document, eval_trace, interactive_chat, multi_agent_discussion, text
instance_display.description: How each item is rendered. Omit for plain single-field text.

key.description: Field in the data file to render.

type.description: Display type, from the display registry.

oneOf.description: Agent trace display with step cards and type badges
Audio player display
Podcast / interview dialogue: speaker bubbles, per-turn audio playback, ratings, spans, cross-turn linking
Source code display with syntax highlighting
Coding agent trace display with diff rendering, terminal blocks, and file tree
Conversation tree with collapsible branching nodes
Long chain-of-thought trace: vertical step cards with a sticky progress rail for process-reward verification
Depth map with windowing, colormap and a metre readout
Dialogue/conversation turns, optionally threaded by reply-to with timestamps and per-turn metadata
Document display for DOCX, Markdown, and other formats
Three-pane agent trace eval: reasoning, function calls, and final answer side-by-side
Scrollable image gallery with captions
HTML content display (sanitized)
Image display with optional zoom
Interactive agent chat with post-interaction trace display
Live AI agent viewer with real-time screenshots, controls, and interaction
Live coding agent viewer with real-time streaming and intervention controls
Multi-agent discussion with agent legend, colors, addressees, and filtering
Side-by-side comparison display
PDF document display with PDF.js rendering
Spreadsheet/table display with row or cell annotation
Plain text content display
Video player display
Web agent trace viewer with screenshots, SVG overlays, and step navigation

category_key.description: Field used by the category_based assignment strategy.

id_key.description: Field holding each item's unique id.

text_key.description: Field holding the text shown to annotators.

task_dir.description: Working directory for all relative paths. Paths resolving outside it are rejected by validate_path_security().
